title: Houthis Seize Strategic Mayyun Island in Bab al-Mandeb Strait
detail: Houthi forces seized Mayyun (Perim) Island, a 13-square-kilometer volcanic landmass at the center of the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, on September 11, 2026, with the takeover confirmed by military officials the following day. Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces reportedly withdrew quickly as the Houthis advanced. The group also took the adjacent Greater and Lesser Hanish islands, extending its reach over a strait that carries roughly 12% of global trade and giving it a direct military foothold over one of the world's most important shipping chokepoints. The seizure followed the Sep 10 capture of Mocha and deepened concerns over the security of Red Sea navigation.
